title: Viral Stasis Dog
description: A large tricolor dog with long flowing black and golden fur stands centered, tongue out, surrounded by multiple colorful hands holding smartphones. The phones display the same dog and are chained to its neck. A swirling vortex of TikTok logos, hearts, fire emojis, and running horses emanates from the dog's head against a psychedelic mountain backdrop.
prompt: A majestic tricolor dog with golden and black fur stands in the center with its tongue out, its long hair transforming into a swirling hypnotic vortex filled with floating TikTok logos, pink hearts, fire emojis, and running horses. Multiple brightly colored hands in pink, blue, and yellow reach up from the bottom holding smartphones displaying the same dog, all chained to the dog's neck. The word STASIS drips in green slime across its chest. Psychedelic colorful mountains and dripping paint in the background, vibrant surreal digital art style.
